Trump's Influence Over His Base

Trump's influence over his base has been a significant factor in the ousting of wayward Republicans. This influence has led to the defeat of several Republicans who have been deemed disloyal to Trump.

Massie's Primary Defeat

Massie's primary defeat in Kentucky is the latest example of Trump's influence over his base. The defeat is a significant blow to Massie, who has been a vocal critic of Trump in the past.

Impact of Trump's Influence

The impact of Trump's influence over his base cannot be overstated. It has led to a shift in the Republican party, with many Republicans now more loyal to Trump than to the party itself. This shift has significant implications for the future of the Republican party and American politics as a whole.

Key Takeaways

  • Trump's influence over his base has led to the ousting of wayward Republicans.
  • Massie's primary defeat in Kentucky is the latest example of Trump's influence.
  • The impact of Trump's influence has significant implications for the future of the Republican party and American politics.
